about:
Lawrence Foods, Inc. was founded in 1890 by Major Lawrence in Elk Grove Village, Illinois. The company remains family-owned and traces its roots to the establishment of Ad. Seidel & Son, Inc. and Hilker & Bletsch in Chicago, with Lawrence Foods expanding from there. The founder's dedication to quality and service set the culture that continues today.

The company operates a 293,000-square-foot facility in Elk Grove Village where it manufactures a broad line of premium bakery ingredients. Its product catalog includes icings, fruit fillings, crème fillings, dry mixes, fondant, glazes, fruit preparations, jellies and preserves, nutrition bar components, and savory spreads. Technical staff includes a chief chemist, food technologists, and master bakers who support product development and testing in a working baking environment.

Lawrence Foods serves commercial food manufacturers, in-store supermarket bakeries, foodservice operators, retail bakery operations (from largest to smallest), and distributors across the United States. Its ingredients are used across the baking industry.

The company differentiates itself by not owning orchards or agricultural processing plants, allowing it to source fruit from the freshest seasonal regions. It also maintains a working baking environment within its testing laboratory to better understand customer challenges and develop ingredient solutions. It has held SQF Level 3 certification for the past five years.
